_comment: English menu copy for en/popular-menu.html. The catalogue (data/planner-overrides.json) stores Thai names only, so the English page is generated from this file plus the catalogue: id -> { name, desc }. A live menu missing here fails the build, so the Thai and English menu pages can never list different dishes or different prices.

3.name: Pad Thai with Fresh Shrimp
3.desc: Soft rice noodles in a balanced tamarind sauce with plump fresh shrimp and egg, plus bean sprouts, chives, peanuts and lime.

6.name: Chicken with Garlic and Fried Egg
6.desc: Crispy garlic-fried chicken served over jasmine rice with a fried egg and fresh vegetables.

8.name: Salted Beef Fried Rice with Bird's Eye Chili
8.desc: Tender diced salted beef wok-fried with fragrant rice and Chinese seasoning, lifted with bird's eye chili.

14.name: Teriyaki Chicken with Fruit
14.desc: Large tender chicken pieces grilled until fragrant, finished with our rich teriyaki glaze and served with fresh fruit.

16.name: Chicken Thigh Biryani
16.desc: Fragrant spiced biryani rice served with a tender chicken thigh. It looks impressive on the table and still disappears fast.

17.name: Kua Kling Minced Chicken
17.desc: Southern Thai dry-fried minced chicken with a deep curry-powder heat, makrut lime and lemongrass. Properly fiery.

20.name: Chicken Drumstick Biryani
20.desc: Fragrant spiced biryani rice served with a large, tender chicken drumstick.

24.name: Spiced Fried Chicken + Yellow Rice
24.desc: Fragrant basil-spiced fried chicken with turmeric yellow rice.

29.name: Beef Basil Fried Rice with Fruit
29.desc: Beef stir-fried with holy basil, garlic and chili, served with steamed rice and fresh seasonal fruit.

114.name: Executive Premium Box: Beef Basil Fried Rice + Fried Egg + Clear Soup + Fruit
114.desc: Our premium box set: beef basil fried rice, fried egg, clear tofu-chicken soup and fresh fruit, in special packaging. Made for VIP tables and important events.

115.name: Spiced Fried Chicken + Duck Curry + Fruit
115.desc: Crispy fried chicken with a deep, sweet-sour duck curry and chilled fresh fruit to finish.

116.name: Spiced Fried-Rice Fish with Chicken Soup
116.desc: Pan-fried rice with tender fish and fragrant basil, served with a warm chicken soup in the same box.

117.name: Crab Fried Rice
117.desc: Fragrant wok-hei rice packed with sweet, succulent crab meat. Hard to stop at one mouthful.

118.name: Teriyaki Rice with Fried Egg
118.desc: Thai-style fluffy omelette over hot rice with a rich sweet-savoury teriyaki glaze - balanced, lightly sweet and aromatic.

119.name: Seafood Fried Rice with Fruit
119.desc: Wok-fried rice with shrimp and squid for a deep protein hit, finished with fresh fruit to cleanse the palate.

120.name: Chicken Basil Rice with Fried Egg + Fruit
120.desc: Hot basil chicken over fragrant rice, with a crisp-edged fried egg and fresh fruit to finish.

121.name: Beef Basil Rice with Fried Egg + Fruit
121.desc: Fragrant tender beef in a rich basil sauce over hot rice, with a runny fried egg and fresh fruit.

122.name: Spiced Fried Chicken + Fish Curry + Samosa
122.desc: Crispy fried chicken with fragrant hot-and-sour fish curry and a crisp samosa on the side.

123.name: Shrimp Curry Stir-Fry with Fried Egg
123.desc: Wok-fried shrimp in a rich curry-powder sauce with a soft omelette, served over hot rice.

124.name: Crispy Squid with Garlic + Fried Egg
124.desc: Crunchy garlic fried squid with a fluffy omelette - deeply savoury, made for sharing.

125.name: Vegetarian Mixed Vegetable Stir-Fry
125.desc: Colourful seasonal vegetables wok-fried with garlic and Thai chili, seasoned the vegetarian way, with hot rice.

126.name: Green Curry Beef + Fried Egg
126.desc: Tender beef in a fragrant green curry with coconut milk, plus a soft omelette. Served with hot rice.

127.name: Tom Yum Seafood Fried Rice + Boiled Egg
127.desc: Rice fried in a tom yum seafood broth with makrut lime, lemongrass and chili, finished with a soft-boiled egg.

128.name: Chicken Green Curry Rice with Fried Egg
128.desc: Fragrant chicken green curry with rich coconut milk, over hot rice with a fried egg.

129.name: Crispy Fried Fish with Garlic
129.desc: Crispy fried fish with plenty of garlic, served with hot rice.

130.name: Pad Thai with Fresh Shrimp in Egg Wrap
130.desc: Soft noodles and plump shrimp wrapped in a thin egg, crisp outside and tender within, in a sweet-savoury tamarind glaze, finished with bean sprouts and fresh vegetables.

toppings._comment: English names for the topping list on the menu page. Keyed by the Thai name in data/planner-overrides.json so a topping cannot drift between the two language pages. A published topping with no entry here fails the build, exactly like a dish with no copy: an English visitor must never be handed a Thai name.
